title: Graffiti Punk Girl
description: A stylized female character with voluminous red and magenta hair stands in a dynamic pose against a solid gray background. She wears a red crop top, red shorts, a black belt with gold buckle, red platform boots, and holds a spray can with a skull design in her right hand while her left hand is extended with an open palm.
prompt: A fierce punk rock girl with wild voluminous red and magenta hair styled in a large messy updo, wearing a red bra top, red shorts, black belt, and red platform combat boots. She has blue eyes, dramatic makeup, and holds a spray paint can with a skull logo in one hand while posing dynamically with the other hand open. Vibrant digital character art on a plain gray background, cartoonish yet detailed style.
